title: Combined tagging | worked scenarios
notes: All examples are hypothetical mappings, not actual GDELT records. GKG theme candidates must be checked against records; never invent native codes or measures.

values.scenario: Hypothetical: European chip vendor announces an ultra-low-power NPU research prototype
values.cameo_handling: No forced CAMEO; only populate if actual event row exists
values.evidence_caveat: Prototype/announcement; verify vendor release, paper and measurement conditions

values.scenario: Hypothetical: Canadian laboratory receives a public research grant for MEMS sensors
values.cameo_handling: 07 root only if GDELT actually emits aid event; do not infer
values.evidence_caveat: Grant award notice; distinguish grant from purchase and research from marketed part

values.scenario: Hypothetical: two civilian aerospace firms announce a launch-service partnership
values.cameo_handling: 03/05 candidates only if source coding supports; no synthetic EventCode
values.evidence_caveat: Company statements; MoU vs binding contract

values.scenario: Hypothetical: EO provider releases agricultural monitoring product
values.evidence_caveat: Confirm product availability and API/license; no inference of owned satellites

values.scenario: Hypothetical: government proposes new semiconductor export rules
values.evidence_caveat: Proposal vs enacted law; check official legal text

values.scenario: Hypothetical: flood reports disrupt electricity supply
values.cameo_handling: No forced CAMEO: disaster itself may be outside action taxonomy
values.evidence_caveat: Location role and time; verify quantities independently

values.scenario: Hypothetical: article describes a new low-power FPGA for industrial sensing
values.evidence_caveat: Datasheet and measured energy per workload; tag not a performance observation

values.scenario: Hypothetical: repeated press release across 30 news sites
values.cameo_handling: Any observed event; do not multiply unique events
values.evidence_caveat: 30 documents may reflect one syndicated story; no invented independent corroboration
